classFeature.name: Hunter Subclass
entries: You gain a Hunter subclass of your choice. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Hunter levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Hunter level or lower.

classFeature.name: Subclass Feature
entries: You gain a feature from your Hunter Subclass.

subclassFeature.name: Pet Specialization
entries: This feature replaces the {@classFeature Roving|Ranger|XPHB|6} feature for a Hunter with the {@subclass Beast Master|Hunter|WoW|WoW} subclass.

While the beast from your {@subclassFeature Primal Companion|Ranger|XPHB|Beast Master|XPHB|3|XPHB} feature is within 60 feet of you, you gain one of the following benefits, depending on the beast's pet family and its specialization (see "{@book Hunter Pets|WoW|1|Hunter Pets}").

entries.name: Cunning
entries: Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} and all of your primal beast's speeds increase by 10 feet. In addition, your primal beast can use its action to cast {@spell Freedom of Movement|XPHB} without any spell components, affecting itself and you (if you are within range). Once it does so, it can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Ferocity
entries: When your primal beast is {@status Bloodied|XPHB} and it hits with its Beast's Strike attack, you and your primal beast each regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your Wisdom modifier. In addition, your primal beast can use its action to cast {@spell Haste|XPHB} without any spell components, affecting itself and you (if you are within range). Once it does so, it can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Tenacity
entries: Your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum increases by 6. Whenever you gain a Ranger level, your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum increases by an additional 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}. Your primal beast's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum also increases by your Ranger level. In addition, your primal beast can use its action to cast {@spell Stoneskin|XPHB} without any spell components, affecting itself and you (if you are within range). Once it does so, it can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Roving
entries: Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing Heavy armor. You also have a {@variantrule Climb Speed|XPHB} and a {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.
